map.Cochran 公式计算最小样本量: Cochran formula for the minimum sample size
map.：参数：置信水平 95%（z=1.960）、误差 E=5%（即 0.05）、总体: Parameters: confidence level 95% (z=1.960), error E=5% (that is 0.05), population proportion p=0.5, infinite population. The Cochran formula gives n₀ = z²·p(1−p)/E² = 1.96²×0.25/0.05² = 384.16, and rounding up gives a minimum sample size of 385. If the population is N=500, the finite population correction gives n = 385/(1+384/500) ≈ 216.
map.p 取多少合适？: What value of p should I use?
map.当预期比例未知时取 p=0.5，此时 p(1−p) 最大，得到最保守（最大）的样: When the expected proportion is unknown, take p=0.5; p(1−p) is then largest, giving the most conservative (largest) sample size so you never underestimate.

map.本工具界面输入百分比如 5，内部按 0.05 计算；E 越小所需样本量越大（与: This tool takes a percentage such as 5 on the interface and computes with 0.05 internally; the smaller E is, the larger the required sample (inversely proportional to E²).
